lines.text: Warned by an angel in a dream, Joseph takes the Child and His mother to Egypt by night.
Joseph stays in Egypt until the death of Herod, fulfilling the words "Out of Egypt I called My Son."
Herod, filled with rage at being outwitted by the Magi, kills all the boys in Bethlehem aged two and under.
Jeremiah's words are fulfilled as a voice is heard in Gilead, with Rachel weeping for her children.
After Herod dies, Joseph returns to Israel, is afraid to go to Judea, and settles in Capernaum in Galilee.
